title: Adding ReflectionProbe in Compatibility renderer causes a crash
body: ### Tested versions - v4.5.1.stable.official [f62fdbde1] - v4.5.2.rc.custom_build [f782f6ad0] ### System information Godot v4.5.2.rc (f782f6ad0) - macOS Sequoia (15.7.3) - Multi-window, 2 monitors - OpenGL 3 (Compatibility) - Apple M4 - Apple M4 (10 threads) - 24.00 GiB memory ### Issue description If I add a ReflectionProbe to this scene, the editor crashes. I'm using the **Copatibility renderer**. Through some testing I narrowed the issue down to the Environment being used. The environment resource is included in the MRP. --- Crash report: ```text ================================================================ handle_crash: Program crashed with signal 11 Engine version: Godot Engine v4.5.2.rc.custom_build (f782f6ad05cae079d1e708d1c5c11f43910f6b8e) Dumping the backtrace. ./bin/godot.macos.editor.arm64 --path -e ``` ### Steps to reproduce 1. Open the MRP 2. Open the scene `crash.tscn` 3. Add ReflectionProbe node 4. The editor crashes The `no_crash.tscn` is VERY similar, but it has just the built-in world environment (added via the top toolbar) and the reflection probe doesn't mind at all. ### Minimal reproduction project (MRP) I copied the problematic Environment resource into a separate project and managed to reproduce the issue.
